messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Incident P-51234 fired for service hosted-inference-prod - high 5xx spike and request failures. Link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/P51234 -- triggered by suppression policy toggle.
Robin: acknowledging, I'm oncall. grabbing the incident in PD now. can someone post a quick customer-impact summary?
Alex: watching metrics — 5xx rate up to ~42% across inference-pool-v3 in us-east-1. latency also up ~30% pct. Affects both text-gen and chat endpoints. ~15% user-facing error rate on production traffic.
Maya: PD shows primary didn't ack — looks like a suppression rule flip re-fired alerts then PD auto-escalated after primary unacked timeout. secondary got duplicated pages.
Luis: seeing a flurry of PD events in the audit log, suppression_scheduled -> suppression_cleared -> re-fired. probably the config change from earlier today.
Robin: plan: 1) silence duplicate PD alerts 2) route traffic to us-west fallback pool 3) attempt quick rollback of suppression rule change 4) open bridge if needed. anyone able to switch route?
Jordan: I'll flip routing. Redirecting ~30% of traffic to us-west-2 fallback now.
Jordan: (after) Routing change applied, verification in progress.
Samir: running quick health check on model servers.
Samir: ```
# health check
curl -sS https://internal-hosted-inference.us-east-1/health | jq .
{"status":"degraded","failed_shards":5,"avg_latency_ms":310}
```
Alex: logs show transformer-worker OOMs and fast-failure on kv-cache connections. stack traces include repeated "KVCache: missing segment" errors.
Maya: PD escalated to manager now — manager page fired to @PM-Ops. manager hasn't acked yet.
PM-Ops: on it, paging in parallel. drafting a short customer note for affected seats.
Robin: I'm trying to ack in PagerDuty via mobile but PD mobile is stuck in DND due to my focus mode. Alex, can you take the PD ack?
Alex: ack'd the PD incident and set status to investigating. silenced the noisy duplicates.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Secondary escalation fired to Luis (P-51234) due to primary silence — but duplicate suppression caused multiple secondary pages.
Luis: I'm on the bridge. looking at the suppression toggle change in config repo: `infra/alerts/pd_suppression.yml` shows a new rule with empty scope that re-enabled alerts mid-day. reverting now.
Luis: ```
git revert --no-edit 9f3a2c3 -- infra/alerts/pd_suppression.yml
kubectl apply -f infra/alerts/pd_suppression.yml -n infra
```
Luis: revert applied, PD suppression back to prior state. monitoring for stray re-fires.
Jordan: traffic to us-west is serving fine, error rate dropped for the routed subset to ~1.2%. overall 5xx across prod down to 18% after partial reroute.
Robin: good. can someone run quick autoscaler bump for hosted-inference-prod pool? might relieve OOM churn.
Samir: increasing pool target by +2 instances now.
Samir: (after) nodes added, redispatching in-flight requests.
Alex: after reroute + instance bump + suppression revert, 5xx is down to ~4% over last 5m. user impact substantially mitigated.
PM-Ops: customer note drafted: "We experienced elevated errors for inference endpoints due to a misconfigured alert suppression toggle which caused repeated escalations. Traffic was routed to fallback region and additional capacity added. We are continuing investigation and will follow up with a postmortem."
Robin: setting incident status -> resolved in PD in 10m if metrics stable. Any objections?
Maya: no objections. I'll start a short blameless postmortem doc.
Alex: filing a follow-up change to add a guard in CI preventing empty-scope suppression rules.
Luis: ticket created: INF-3247 "safeguard PD suppression toggles" assigned to infra team.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Incident P-51234 resolved by Alex.
Robin: closing thread. great work everyone. postmortem + action items to follow in #postmortems. :white_check_mark:
